_comment: Coin amount overrides. 'default' = [min, max] gold range for research/technology completion coin rewards (a max <= 0 disables the override and the template amount is used); 'coin_word_amounts' = [min, max] gold range per expedition award_display coin word (case-insensitive). Loaded by src/config/coin_override.py; the loader caches, so a server restart is needed to pick up edits.
